note: Illinois DNR park east of Clinton on spring-fed Weldon Springs Lake. The wooded campground sits on a rise above the lake; the east-side sites (71-78) and the south spur (62-66) look through trees to the water 30-55 m away. Showers are open about May 1 to November 1; the campground itself stays open all year. --Claude
